package wasm

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"math"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestNumericFloorSat(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []struct {
		Name string `json:"name"`
		Bits uint64 `json:"bits"`
		Want int32  `json:"want"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(cases) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("missing independent numeric goldens")
	}
	module := New()
	for _, test := range cases {
		value := math.Float64frombits(test.Bits)
		if got := module.Xfloor_sat(value); got != test.Want {
			t.Fatalf("floor-sat mismatch for %s (%016x): %d, want %d", test.Name, test.Bits, got, test.Want)
		}
		module.Xreset()
		if got := module.Xfloor_effect(value); got != test.Want || module.Xcounter() != 1 {
			t.Fatal("numeric argument was not evaluated exactly once", test.Name, got)
		}
	}
}

func TestNumericFloatRounding(t *testing.T) {
	module := New()
	if got := module.Xf64_unfused(1+0x1p-27, 1-0x1p-27, -1); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("f64 multiply/add rounding changed: %016x", got)
	}
	if got := module.Xf32_unfused(1+0x1p-13, 1-0x1p-13, -1); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("f32 multiply/add rounding changed: %08x", got)
	}
	negativeZero := math.Float64frombits(1 << 63)
	if got := module.Xf64_unfused(negativeZero, 1, negativeZero); uint64(got) != 1<<63 {
		t.Fatalf("signed zero rounding changed: %016x", got)
	}
	if got := module.Xrounding_order(1); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("floating additions reassociated: %016x", got)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct{ input, want uint64 }{{1, 0}, {3, 2}} {
		if got := module.Xsubnormal_half(math.Float64frombits(test.input)); uint64(got) != test.want {
			t.Fatalf("subnormal rounding changed: %016x, want %016x", got, test.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestNumericArgumentTrapsAndEffects(t *testing.T) {
	module := New()
	for _, test := range []struct {
		invoke  func()
		name    string
		counter int32
	}{
		{func() { module.Xfloor_trap(65536) }, "store before load", 7},
		{func() { module.Xeffect_then_trap(65536, 1.75) }, "operand evaluation order", 1},
	} {
		module.Xreset()
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recover() == nil {
					t.Fatal("numeric argument lost its bounds trap", test.name)
				}
			}()
			test.invoke()
		}()
		if got := module.Xcounter(); got != test.counter {
			t.Fatal("numeric argument trap reordered effects", test.name, got)
		}
		if got := module.Xfloor_sat(1.75); got != 1 {
			t.Fatal("numeric trap made the module unusable")
		}
	}
	if got := module.Xfloor_trap(8); got != 0 || module.Xcounter() != 9 {
		t.Fatal("valid numeric load or its later side effect changed", got)
	}
}
